{{Top|leg}}
In [[37 ABY]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] passed the '''Sector Defense Limits''', which limited military forces and their capabilities.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The Alliance used the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and military units of its member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to defend its far-flung holdings and to rebuild a devastated [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], while simultaneously placing restrictions on the member worlds' abilities to strike trade agreements and defend their own interests. Powerful economic worlds such as [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] pressured the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] for a loosening of central authority,<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the Alliance found enforcing the limits to be quite the challenge. They kept on [[Politics/Legends|political]] pressure of their own and investigated rumors of determined [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] arming themselves,<ref name="Warfare" /> but the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] nevertheless built a [[Corellian Home Fleet|secret fleet]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> while publicly arguing that the Sector Defense Limits prevented member states from adequately defending themselves in a dangerous age.<ref name="Warfare" /> The Alliance attempted to [[Operation Roundabout|use force]] to quash a Corellian insurrection, but other planetary governments joined the Corellians' [[Confederation|cause]], and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] began.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />
